mode.title: What to collect
mode.description: Story lists (front page, top, new...), keyword search, a story's full comment tree, user profiles with submissions, or the monthly 'Who is hiring' thread.
enumTitles: Story lists (front page, top, new, best, ask, show, jobs)

list.title: List
list.description: Mode 'list'. 'Front page' is the real front page (about 30 stories); 'Top' is the top 500.

lists.title: Several lists (optional)
lists.description: Mode 'list'. Overrides 'List': any of front, top, new, best, ask, show, jobs. Each gets its own max results.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Mode 'search'. One search per entry. Leave empty to match only on the filters below.

sort.title: Search sort
sort.description: Mode 'search'. Relevance returns at most 1,000 hits per keyword; newest first can go further back.

since.title: Since (search)
since.description: Mode 'search'. Only items created on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31 or 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z.

until.title: Until (search)
until.description: Mode 'search'. Only items created before this date.

minPoints.title: Minimum points (search)
minPoints.description: Mode 'search'. Only items with at least this many points.

minComments.title: Minimum comments (search)
minComments.description: Mode 'search'. Only stories with at least this many comments.

storyIds.title: Story IDs or URLs
storyIds.description: Mode 'thread'. Item IDs or news.ycombinator.com/item?id=... URLs. Returns the story and all its comments, flattened.

includeSubmissions.title: Include submissions (users)
includeSubmissions.description: Mode 'user'. Also return the user's stories and comments, newest first.

hiringMonth.title: Month (hiring)
hiringMonth.description: Mode 'hiring'. Month like 2026-11. Empty = the latest thread.

maxItems.title: Max results per entry
maxItems.description: Maximum results for each list / keyword / story / user / thread. You are charged per result.
